notes.title: Release Hotfixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've released a small patch containing post-release fixes!
Here is what we fixed:

 Add checkpoint in the final boss battle
 Introduction animation bug
 Pause menu not opening in some rare cases
 New game does not reset the last game properly
 UI localization update
 Player getting stuck on object during grab
 Some collider fixes

Thank you for playing Last Stretch!
- Team Zandt
